component.name: Kadenza
component.summary: A native Apple Music client for KDE Plasma

description.p: Kadenza brings an adaptive, desktop-integrated Kirigami interface for browsing and listening to Apple Music on KDE Plasma.

Browse your library, search the Apple Music catalog, manage a playback queue, and control playback from a native Qt application. Licensed playback runs through an isolated MusicKit and Widevine sidecar.
